ar: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يعتكف العشر الأواخر من رمضان. ((متفق عليه))
en: Ibn `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe I`tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. .
v: Our source carries no chain grading for this collection. Treat it as a reference, and verify an individual narration before relying on it.

ar: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يعتكف العشر الأواخر من رمضان، حتى توفاه الله، تعالى ثم اعتكف أزواجه من بعده. ((متفق عليه))
en: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to engage himself in I'tikaf (seclusion for prayers) in the mosque during the last ten nights of Ramadan till he passed away; thereafter, his wives followed this practice after him..
v: Our source carries no chain grading for this collection. Treat it as a reference, and verify an individual narration before relying on it.

ar: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعتكف في كل رمضان عشرة أيام، فلما كان العام الذي قبض فيه اعتكف عشرين يومًا ((رواه البخاري)).
en: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to observe I'tikaf every year (during Ramadan) for ten days; in the year in which he passed away, he observed I'tikaf for twenty days..
v: Our source carries no chain grading for this collection. Treat it as a reference, and verify an individual narration before relying on it.
